# Knackbox

> Open, auditable library of Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and any runtime that loads the Agent Skills format.

Knackbox ranks skills with independent measurement columns (trigger accuracy, quality uplift, context cost) and ships every skill with a benchmark suite. Source of truth is the GitHub repository; this site is a static catalog.

- Catalog version: v0
- Generated: 2026-08-16
- Skills: 122 across 6 categories

## Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/shinzoxD/knackbox
- License: Apache-2.0
- Skills tree: https://github.com/shinzoxD/knackbox/tree/main/skills

## Install

```bash
npx knackbox add commit-messages
npx skills add shinzoxD/knackbox --skill commit-messages
```

Dependency-free:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shinzoxD/knackbox/main/install.sh | bash -s commit-messages
```

## Categories

coding, data, documents, productivity, research, writing

## Starter packs

- Developer Essentials (`developer-essentials`): Plan, implement, test, review, secure, and ship software with a consistent engineering workflow.
- Quality & Accessibility (`quality-and-a11y`): Review product quality from security, accessibility, performance, i18n, and defect triage angles.
- Platform & Infra (`platform-and-infra`): Review infrastructure-as-code, containers, CI/CD, GraphQL platforms, and AI agent hardening.
- Data Workbench (`data-workbench`): Clean inputs, define metrics, analyze experiments, write warehouse SQL, and communicate findings.
- Research Rigor (`research-rigor`): Verify claims, synthesize sources and interviews, and produce decision-ready competitive briefs.
- Clear Writing (`clear-writing`): Draft and edit writing across email, articles, launches, social, and incident communications.
- Project Leadership (`project-leadership`): Turn uncertain work into decisions, designs, plans, status, agendas, and durable records.
- Ops & Reliability (`ops-reliability`): Operate systems under stress: runbooks, incidents, migrations, errors, performance, and comms.
- Career & Hiring (`career-and-hiring`): Prepare candidates and interviewers with structured practice and clear storytelling.
- Customer Facing (`customer-facing`): Support macros, incident customer updates, announcements, and clear external writing.
- Privacy & Trust (`privacy-and-trust`): Handle privacy requests, support judgment, security reviews, and careful external communications.
- Team Operating System (`team-operating-system`): Run the team: OKRs, agendas, onboarding, status, retros, and delegation.
- OSS Maintainers (`oss-maintainers`): Triage community contributions, write onboarding for contributors, and keep public repos healthy.
- Product & GTM (`product-gtm`): Ship narratives and proof: case studies, launches, market sizing, RFPs, and research synthesis.
- Realtime & Edge (`realtime-and-edge`): Design sockets, caching, rate limits, and resilient edge behavior.
- AI Builders (`ai-builders`): Write, evaluate, and harden prompts and tool-using agents instead of shipping on vibes.
- Mobile Shipping (`mobile-shipping`): Ship iOS and Android trains with release checklists, flags, CI, and store-safe comms.
- Identity & Trust (`identity-and-trust`): Design login, sessions, webhooks, and threat models before the first security review.
